scripts.build: npm run packages:build && npm run backend:build && npm run frontend:build
scripts.start: npm run build && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run backend:start" "npm run frontend:preview"
scripts.dev: npm run packages:build && concurrently -n backend,frontend -c blue,green "npm run backend:dev" "npm run frontend:dev"
scripts.preview: npm run frontend:build && npm run frontend:preview
scripts.lint: npm run frontend:lint && npm run backend:lint
scripts.typecheck: npm run frontend:typecheck && npm run backend:typecheck
scripts.test: npm run frontend:test && npm run backend:test
scripts.packages:build: npm run build --workspace=@packages/enum && npm run build --workspace=@packages/types && npm run build --workspace=@packages/utils
scripts.setup:data: mkdir apps\backend\data\bathymetry_rasters && curl -L https://pharos-bathymetry-bucket.s3.eu-central-1.amazonaws.com/bathymetry_rasters.zip -o bathymetry_rasters.zip && tar -xf bathymetry_rasters.zip -C app/backend/data/bathymetry_rasters/ && del bathymetry_rasters.zip
